strings.Value: Ecclesitheurge's Vow

At 1st level, an ecclesitheurge makes a vow to his deity to be protected solely by his faith, not by armor or shields. An ecclesitheurge who wears armor or uses a shield is unable to use his blessing of the faithful ability, use cleric domain powers, or cast cleric spells.

At 1st level, an ecclesitheurge makes a vow to his deity to be protected solely by his faith, not by armor or shields. An ecclesitheurge who wears armor or uses a shield is unable to cast cleric spells.
Supernatural Speed

This creature moves with incredible speed. It gains a +2 enhancement bonus to natural armor, +4 bonus to all {g|Encyclopedia:Ability_Scores}ability scores{/g} and +10 bonus to {g|Encyclopedia:Dexterity}Dexterity{/g}, +30 bonus to {g|Encyclopedia:Speed}speed{/g}, extra {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attack{/g} with full {g|Encyclopedia:BAB}BAB{/g}, Evasion and Uncanny Dodge abilities, it cannot be {g|Encyclopedia:Flanking}flanked{/g} and it is always under the effect of the {g|SpellsBlur}blur{/g} spell.

At 16th level, a winter child sacrifices a part of her soul to let a great blizzard spirit into the material world. Her blizzard servant gains the following benefits: Huge {g|Encyclopedia:Size}size{/g}, +4 {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:Strength}Strength{/g}, +6 bonus to {g|Encyclopedia:Dexterity}Dexterity{/g}, +4 bonus to {g|Encyclopedia:Constitution}Constitution{/g}, +2 natural armor bonus to {g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}AC{/g}, the numbing cold ability, and cold {g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Resistance}resistance{/g} 30. If the Winter Child already has an animal companion, it only receives half the bonuses and does not increase in size. In addition, whenever an ally hits an enemy affected by the blizzard servant's whirlwind of hail ability, that enemy takes an additional {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}2d6{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Damage}cold damage{/g}. Numbing cold: Whenever the blizzard elemental or an animal companion deals {g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Damage}cold damage{/g} to a creature, that creature must succeed at a {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}Fortitude saving throw{/g} (DC 10 + 1/2 level + {g|Encyclopedia:Constitution}Constitution{/g} modifier) or be {g|ConditionStaggered}staggered{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}round{/g}.

Whenever the blizzard elemental or an animal companion deals {g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Damage}cold damage{/g} to a creature, that creature must succeed at a {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}Fortitude saving throw{/g} (DC 10 + 1/2 level + {g|Encyclopedia:Constitution}Constitution{/g} modifier) or be {g|ConditionStaggered}staggered{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}round{/g}.

At 4th level, a winter child forms a bond with a blizzard elemental. This ability functions like the druid's animal companion ability, except that the winter child's effective druid level is equal to her druid level –3 and she can only select a blizzard elemental as her companion. This companion can't be used as a mount. A blizzard elemental has the Animal type instead of Outsider, but still has the extraplanar subtype. This replaces wild shape. Blizzard elemental stats: {g|Encyclopedia:Size}Size{/g}: Small {g|Encyclopedia:Speed}Speed{/g}: 100 ft. {g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}AC{/g}: +3 natural armor {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}Attacks{/g}: spike ({g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d4{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Type}piercing{/g}) {g|Encyclopedia:Ability_Scores}Ability scores{/g}: {g|Encyclopedia:Strength}Str{/g} 14, {g|Encyclopedia:Dexterity}Dex{/g} 16, {g|Encyclopedia:Constitution}Con{/g} 11, {g|Encyclopedia:Intelligence}Int{/g} 3, {g|Encyclopedia:Wisdom}Wis{/g} 14, {g|Encyclopedia:Charisma}Cha{/g} 8 Whirlwind of Hail: A blizzard servant can transform itself into a whirlwind and back again. The whirlwind has a diameter of 40 feet. A creature in whirlwind form cannot make its normal {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attacks{/g} and does not {g|Encyclopedia:Threatened_Area}threaten{/g} the area around it. Creatures caught in the whirlwind take a –4 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:Dexterity}Dexterity{/g} and a –2 penalty on attack rolls and must succeed on a {g|Encyclopedia:Concentration}concentration{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Check}check{/g} ({g|Encyclopedia:DC}DC{/g} 15 + {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spell{/g} level) to cast a spell. An affected creature must succeed on a {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}Reflex save{/g} (DC 10 + half the blizzard servant's level + its {g|Encyclopedia:Strength}Strength{/g} modifier) each {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}round{/g} or take {g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Type}bludgeoning{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}damage{/g} as if it were hit by the blizzard servant's spike attack. Blizzard Incarnate: A blizzard elemental is immune to the effects of whirlwind of hail (except for the {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}damage{/g} dealt by another elemental) and any natural snowstorms.

You surround your allies with a constant and moveable 1 inch thick shell of tolerable living conditions. This shell enables the subjects to breathe freely, even underwater or in a vacuum, as well as making them immune to harmful gases and vapors, including inhaled diseases and poisons and {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spells{/g} like {g|SpellsCloudkill}cloudkill{/g} and {g|SpellsStinkingCloud}stinking cloud{/g}.
Mythic creature I
Mythic creature II

This mythic creature ignores any immunities its enemies have, deals additional sacred {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}damage{/g} equal to half its normal damage, and when making a d20 roll against the target's {g|Encyclopedia:Spell_Resistance}spell resistance{/g}, it rolls the {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}die{/g} again and takes the better result.
Distorted mythic creature I

If this mythic creature's {g|Encyclopedia:HP}hit points{/g} become negative, one of its {g|Encyclopedia:Ability_Scores}ability scores{/g} drops to 0 or lower, or it suffers an effect that causes instant {g|Encyclopedia:Injury_Death}death{/g}, it does not die. Instead, it falls unconscious, becomes {g|ConditionProne}prone{/g}, fully restores its hit points after 1 round, then stands up under the effects of the {g|SpellsHaste}Haste{/g} spell and the Mythic Overcharge condition. It can no longer cast {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spells{/g} or use {g|Encyclopedia:Special_Abilities}extraordinary and supernatural abilities{/g}. While the creature is unconscious and has not restored its hit points, it cannot be targeted by any effect. If any of its ability scores were 0 or lower before it fell unconscious, they become 1. The creature continues to suffer from all other negative effects. Once a mythic creature benefits from this ability, it can no longer use it again. This ability does not protect the creature from instant death caused by level drain. Mythic Overcharge: This mythic creature deals direct {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}damage{/g} to itself each round equal to its Challenge Rating.
Distorted mythic creature II

If this mythic creature has benefited from the "Distorted mythic creature I" ability, it can continue to cast {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spells{/g} and use {g|Encyclopedia:Special_Abilities}extraordinary and supernatural abilities{/g}. It also gains {g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Resistance}resistance{/g} to fire, cold, sonic, electricity, acid, negative energy, and positive energy, as well as {g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Reduction}damage reduction{/g} N/-, equal to half its Challenge Rating.
Mythic creature III

This mythic creature can use the Demonic Rage ability of the Demon mythic path at will, using its mythic level as its effective Demon level. Demonic Rage: The power of the Abyss courses through the Demon, waiting to be unleashed. The Demon can enter a demonic rage as a {g|Encyclopedia:Free_Action}free action{/g}. The demonic rage lasts until the end of combat. While in a demonic rage, the Demon gains a +2 {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} on {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attack rolls{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}damage rolls{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}caster level{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Check}checks{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}Reflex saving throws{/g}. The {g|Encyclopedia:DC}DCs{/g} for all saving throws against the Demon's {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spells{/g} and abilities are increased by 2. These benefits increase by 1 at 6th and 9th mythic ranks. You can use demonic rage 3 times per day. The number of uses increases by 1 at 6th and 9th mythic ranks.
Mythic creature IV
This mythic creature gains a {g|Encyclopedia:Fast_Healing}fast healing{/g} ability equal to its Challenge Rating.
Mythic Overcharge
This mythic creature deals direct {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}damage{/g} to itself each round equal to its Challenge Rating.
Mythic distortion
This mythic creature has become distorted and can no longer benefit from the mythic powers "Mythic creature III" and "Mythic creature IV", but gains the mythic power "Distorted mythic creature I".

By taking a {g|Encyclopedia:Standard_Actions}standard action{/g}, the Aeon can attempt to suppress the effects of the mythic powers (Mythic creature I, Mythic creature II, and Distorted mythic creature I) of its enemies. This ability only affects mythic creatures. A creature can resist the ability by succeeding at a {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}Will save{/g} ({g|Encyclopedia:DC}DC{/g} 10 + mythic level + the Aeon's {g|Encyclopedia:Intelligence}Intelligence{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:Wisdom}Wisdom{/g}, or  {g|Encyclopedia:Charisma}Charisma{/g} modifier (whichever is higher), but not less than 10 + 2 * mythic level). The DC is 4 lower for non-distorted mythic creatures.
Starting at 7th mythic level, distorted mythic creatures can no longer get a saving throw to resist the effect, and non-distorted mythic creatures no longer have a lower saving throw DC.
Starting at 9th mythic level, mythic creatures can't save against this ability.

A tortured crusader can call out to the powers of good to aid her in her struggle against evil. As a {g|Encyclopedia:Swift_Action}swift action{/g}, the tortured crusader chooses one target within sight to smite. The tortured crusader adds half her {g|Encyclopedia:Wisdom}Wisdom{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} (minimum 1) to her {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attack rolls{/g} and adds her paladin level to all {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}damage rolls{/g} made against the target of her smite. In addition, while smite evil is in effect, the tortured crusader gains a +4 deflection bonus to her {g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}AC{/g} against attacks made by the target of the smite. Smite evil lasts until the target dies or the tortured crusader selects a new target. A tortured crusader can use this ability once per day at 1st level, and one additional time per day for every 5 levels she has, to a total of 5 times per day at 20th level (not counting the 3 additional uses granted by her unbroken paragon feature at 20th level).
Smite evil lasts until the target dies or the tortured crusader selects a new target.
This ability can be used on any creature, not just evil ones.
